label: preparing
what: A coordinated jubilee gathering for my forty years as mayor, apparently at the great hall under cover of the eighteen-hundred lantern inspection. Baker and Freight are supplying a planned 200 fresh loaves, innkeeper verifies deliveries, and builder arranges my escort and the lantern inspection. Secretary knowingly helps with scheduling and supply verification. The journal already identifies the jubilee, so its existence is no longer wholly secret; the full arrangements remain undisclosed. No clear evidence that neighbour or watchman knowingly participates.
